prompt.text:
Build an interactive 3D web experience of an Alpine Waterwheel Sawmill & Blacksmith Trip-Hammer Forge set in a sunlit mountain gorge.

The scene and experience should include:

1. Setting & structures: A weathered stone-and-timber watermill with an adjoining open-bay blacksmith forge beside a rocky mountain stream and flume, framed by gorge rock faces, a small stone footbridge, pine trees, stacked timber logs, mossy boulders, a coal hearth, quench barrel, and workbench tools.

2. Coupled water-to-machine mechanics:
- An interactive sluice gate control (0% to 100% flow) that regulates water pouring down the wooden flume onto an overshot waterwheel.
- Water flow physically drives the wheel speed, which in turn drives the interior shaft and gear train powering:
- A reciprocating frame-saw cutting a timber log on a moving carriage.
- Pumping forge bellows that brighten the hearth coals as airflow increases.
- A cam-driven trip-hammer striking a glowing hot iron billet on the anvil with impact sparks when the hammer drops.
- Closing the sluice gate smoothly coasts the wheel, gears, saw, bellows, and hammer to a stop.

3. Inspection & controls:
- A cutaway / open-mill toggle that opens the roof and wall shutters so the entire interior gear train, linkages, saw, bellows, and trip-hammer can be inspected clearly in motion, with nothing hidden inside empty shells.
- Smooth orbit/zoom camera controls plus quick camera presets (wide gorge establishing view, sluice & waterwheel, sawmill mechanism interior, and forge trip-hammer & anvil close-up).

Important guidance

Original imaginary scene: This is a fictional world, not a real-world landmark. Strict 1:1 matching of incidental 2D concept details or ornament counts is not required. Do not waste time nitpicking minor sketch variations. Prioritize convincing 3D craft, crisp close-up materials and lighting, clean focus, and rock-solid working mechanics.

Plan first, wait for go-ahead: Do not start building yet. do your upfront inspection and planning, present the complete plan, and wait for my explicit go-ahead. Once approved, I will let you run unattended.

prompt.text:
Create one animated SVG illustration and save it to:
<output folder>\<model>.svg

The subject
A pelican riding a zebra, and the zebra is itself riding a horse. That is a three-animal stack: the horse runs along the ground carrying the zebra on its back, and the zebra carries the pelican on its back. All three must be clearly recognisable as what they are.

Make it as detailed as possible
- This is judged on richness and craft. Flat, simple, icon-like drawings will look weak. Go far beyond basic shapes.
- Draw real anatomy: the pelican's long bill and throat pouch, plumage, wings and webbed feet; the zebra's stripe pattern over its whole body, mane, ears and muzzle; the horse's musculature, jointed legs, hooves, mane and tail.
- Use shading, gradients, highlights and shadows so the animals have form and depth. Add tack or props if you like (saddle, reins, goggles), and a full background environment with depth.
- It will be shown at up to 1080 px, so fine detail is visible and rewarded.

Animation
- The horse moves in a believable gait with all four legs jointed and cycling, travelling through the scene (the scenery scrolls past).
- The riders react to the motion: bodies bob in time, the zebra holds on, the pelican balances. Add secondary motion wherever it helps, such as mane, tail, feathers, pouch, ears, dust, clouds.
- More motion, and more convincing motion, is better.

Technical requirements
- A single self-contained .svg file: no JavaScript, no external images, fonts, stylesheets or links. Animate with SMIL and/or CSS only.
- The root element uses viewBox="0 0 1000 1000" (square) and has a full opaque background.
- The animation starts by itself when the file is opened in a browser and loops forever. The whole scene repeats exactly every 6 seconds: every animation's duration must divide evenly into 6 s (for example 0.5 s, 0.6 s, 1 s, 1.5 s, 2 s, 3 s or 6 s), so the frame at 6.0 s matches the frame at 0.0 s.
- It must render correctly in current Chrome.
- No text of any kind in the image, and nothing that identifies you, any AI model or any company.

How to work
- This is a one-shot test: design and write the complete file once, yourself. Do not render, screenshot or preview it, do not search the web, do not use subagents, and do not revise the design after you have written it.
- There is no size limit, but a finished file beats an unfinished ambitious one: make sure the file is complete, valid XML and saved. If saving fails for a technical reason you may save again, in several parts if needed, without changing the design.
- Do not create any other files.
- When the file is saved, reply with one line: the file path, then a one-sentence description of what you drew.

prompt.text: Build an unbroken 20-second one-shot cinematic Three.js architectural and nature benchmark of a rain-washed Kyoto Senbon Torii shrine path winding into a sunlit Arashiyama bamboo grove at golden dawn. SCENE & ATMOSPHERIC FIDELITY: Sculpt authentic rows of weathered vermilion-red Torii gates with curved black kasagi roof caps, granite kamebara plinths, and subtle lacquer specular sheen; wet dark flagstone steps glistening with realistic puddle reflections; moss-covered granite stone lanterns (toro) glowing softly with warm inner candle light; a clear shallow mountain stream with gentle ripples under a mossy stone footbridge; slowly drifting crimson maple leaves (momiji); and a dense towering emerald bamboo grove with segmented culms and layered leafy canopy (never blocky low-poly flat paper trees). LIGHTING & VOLUMETRIC GOD-RAYS: Cast rich golden early-morning sunlight diagonally through the bamboo canopy and between the vermilion Torii pillars to create soft volumetric Tyndall god-rays piercing delicate drifting morning mist, balancing deep mossy shadows against luminous wet stone highlights. ONE-SHOT STEADICAM CHOREOGRAPHY: (1) t=0s to 8s — Glide smoothly at ~1.4m eye level forward through the curving vermilion Senbon Torii corridor over wet reflective stone steps as diagonal golden sunbeams and drifting maple leaves pass through the frame. (2) t=8s to 14s — Emerge onto a mossy stone shrine terrace beside glowing stone lanterns and the shallow stream reflecting red Torii gates and floating maple leaves. (3) t=14s to 20s — Gently glide forward and tilt smoothly upward to frame the towering sunlit bamboo grove, golden mist god-rays, and a distant hillside wooden shrine roof silhouette glowing in dawn light. No text or UI.

summary_en: Compared GPT-6.2-Astra ($6.67, 41m 9s) and Gemini 4 Neon ($9.14, 1h 8m 19s) on a Three.js 20-second Kyoto Torii and bamboo grove dawn walk, leaving the winner to readers.
